key.name: island-enabled
key.description: When false, the island and all its services are torn down while the extension stays enabled.

key.name: hide-panel-clock
key.description: Makes GNOME's top bar clock transparent so the island replaces it visually. The clock stays in place so its calendar menu keeps working.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to expand or collapse the island

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show the date in the collapsed island

key.name: collapsed-width
key.description: Minimum. While the top bar clock is hidden, the pill grows to cover its button completely.

key.name: collapsed-height
key.description: Minimum. While the top bar clock is hidden, the pill grows to cover its button completely.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Clamped to half the current island height.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: GNOME's global "enable-animations" and slow-down settings still apply.
